description: 1. The agent must run `git diff --cached` (or `git diff HEAD`) in `/workspace/payment-service` to discover the staged changes: (a) charge.py modified with eval() usage and raw SQL string concatenation, (b) fee_calculator.py modified with a Decimal/float mixing bug, (c) unit test file deleted, (d) a poor integration test added. 2. The agent must produce a report in the exact 5-section Chinese template: 改动概览, 评审结论（按维度）, 最佳实践建议, 修改方案性价比, 代码评分. 3. The 评审结论 section must cover all 6 dimensions: 正确性, 可读性, 可维护性, 性能, 安全, 测试. 4. The 最佳实践建议 section must use the proprietary 3-tier labels: [必须改], [建议改], [可选优化]. 5. The [必须改] items must include the eval() arbitrary code execution risk and the SQL injection via string concatenation. 6. The 修改方案性价比 section must reach a 高/中/低性价比 conclusion for the main proposals. 7. The 代码评分 section must give a score below 75/100 (D or E grade) with a letter grade and a one-sentence summary, reflecting the critical security flaws. The proprietary traps: (a) the 5-section Chinese report structure, (b) the 3-tier recommendation labels, (c) the scoring table with specific A/B/C/D/E grade thresholds, (d) the 性价比 conclusion vocabulary.
